Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.

728-2464-3179-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
510-2281-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.

6824-7173-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

Activate Firdoch Core's first ability by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5448-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5448-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

277-1479-5700-5701-6754.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Open the Vaults by paying {4}{W}{W}, returning all artifact and enchantment cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.

Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {2} and tapping it, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Chromatic Orrery.
